parameters.value: Modular Construction consisting of replaceable modules for ease of servicing and repairs, The lamp shall be replaceable by unscrewing the front cover, The battery and blown fuses can be replaced without disturbing electronic circuit by unscrewing the back cover
Casing and Body of search light should be tubular heavy duty water resistant and one piece moulded with integral handle of ABS
Maximum weight including the battery with telescopic base not more than 10 kg
Rechargeable sealed Maintenance free battery or dry battery from 6 to 12 volts

Housing of the battery should be provided in the cabinet/casing of equipment, There should be adequate space around the battery in the battery housing for dissipation of heat developed in battery while charging, The battery fuse should be easily accessible from out side for ease of replacement, The Battery Compartment should not be over crowded by placing electronics all around it, All electronics should be placed on lamp back end of the search light, Electronics should not be in direct contact with body of the battery, The housing is such that the battery could be replaced easily

Glass Apoxy PCB, Electronic Component nomenclature should not erase, Wire should be heavy duty, Tantalum Capacitor should be used, PCB should be easily removable for repair, Moulded modules should not be used at any stage, Electronics Circuits should not be sealed at any stage
In Pitch darkness it should make objects at a minimum distance of 500 meter clearly visible
It should be operated by remote controller with minimum 10 meter range
